t: Arm animation (non-blocking), After-arm display mode, tile messages in footer
Display no longer flickers while the web page is open: an open web page does not pause the display any more (only the ride player still does)
Transmitter → Channel overview now lists all channels (also free ones) with live bar and value; the separate Channels live card on this tab is gone
Tab Buttons is now called Transmitter
Assign channels moved to Transmitter, with Throttle reverse and Steering reverse right there
Outputs → Indicators & brake: new switch Swap left/right indicators – only swaps which LEDs blink
Transmitter button messages now show in the warning line under the menu instead of top right
Everything you do on the transmitter (lights, high beam level, blue lights, hazard, O4, buttons, armed, battery number, volume) now shows on every page within about 0.2 s instead of up to 2 s
Warning line under the menu (ARMED etc.) keeps its space when empty – the page no longer jumps up and down
Update while armed: button top right turns orange with a lock, the big update card turns red and Update now is greyed out
Update card in System refreshes by itself when a newer version appears
Channels live (Buttons and FC tabs): values now update about 7 times per second instead of every 2 s
Sensors → Fan: the three sensor switches (Motor/ESC, LED, O4) are now separate rows, lined up with the other fields
New version numbering: Core and web page are now V2.00 (next: V2.01, V2.02 …)
Buttons: only 1x short, 2x short and long hold – 3x short removed, 2x now reacts right away
Fan and LiDAR pins are fixed as in the wiring plan (fan GPIO 3, LiDAR GPIO 17) – no input fields any more
Outputs → High beam: flash settings (number, brightness, speed), Flash now and Off / last level buttons, and which transmitter buttons are set to high beam
System: Wi-Fi signal now at the very top
System: card Menu order removed – default order is now the ↺ button while editing the tab bar (✎)
